paragraphs: If you chose a Limited Liability Company (LLC), Corporation (Corp), Limited Partnership (LP), or Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) as your business structure, you must register or incorporate with the California Secretary of State.

sections.heading: Check name availability
paragraphs: Check if the name you want is available .
Learn more about how to choose a business name .

sections.heading: File
paragraphs: After you know the name you want is available, file the appropriate forms for your business structure with the CA Secretary of State.

sections.heading: Submit a "Statement of Information"
paragraphs: Once the CA Secretary of State has processed your filing, submit a Statement of Information within 90 days of your filing.
Log in to your account, search and select your entity name. You should see a Statement of Information button to file on the right hand side. The paper form is available here .
